reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every holiday-aware path already calls, using date-fns format alongside monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the yearly match is one extra clause in the single predicate.

placement.why: The holiday matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay, where the tree defines what a non-working day is.

scope.why: A three-line predicate change plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Minimal and obvious; every consumer picks up MM-DD support automatically (only the RecurConfig type lacks a comment documenting the two formats).

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the existing isNonWorkingDay abstraction.
